notes.title: Patch 1.9.6 (Toasty Update)
notes.content:
New patch for Under Rooms demo

The crafting system has been temporarily removed.

All maps have been rebuilt.

More interaction with the environment has been added.

Several bugs from previous versions have been fixed.

The resolution has been set to 1280x720 as default.

The lighting system has been simplified.

And much more...

Thanks Toasty Time!
